data.one_liner: Provides percentage‑based size extensions and device helpers for responsive Flutter UI.
data.what_it_does: Sizer wraps the app in a widget that exposes screen dimensions, orientation and type. It adds extension methods like .w, .h, .sp, .dp to calculate sizes as a percentage of the device screen.
use_when: You need quick, percentage‑based sizing across mobile, web and desktop
You want a lightweight solution without a full layout system
You prefer using extension methods over custom MediaQuery code
avoid_when: You require complex breakpoint grids or advanced layout constraints
You need a theming or widget‑library solution rather than just sizing helpers
strengths: Very easy to integrate – just wrap MaterialApp
Provides many unit conversions (cm, inches, etc.)
weaknesses: Limited to simple percentage sizing, no built‑in breakpoint management
Relies on global Device object which may be less testable
No support for code‑generated responsive widgets

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a full breakpoint system, theming and adaptive widgets for more complex responsive designs

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides builders and utilities for responsive layouts with fine‑grained control

alternatives.name: scaled_app
alternatives.why_pick_it: Scales UI based on design size, useful when you prefer scaling over percentage calculations
